newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barges quoted mostly steady on call session.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barges quoted mostly steady on call session.

text.p: U.S. barge rates were quoted at mostly steady levels on the St. Louis Merchants Exchange call session. No barges traded versus eight barges traded on Southbound Barge Freight Options on Friday, Exchange sources said.
- Two barges, this week, Illinois River, no bid, offer 225 percent.
- One barge, on station, Peoria, no bid, offer 230 percent.
- Four barges, one each week November, Illinois River, no bid, offer 185 percent, unchanged from Friday.
- 10 barges, two each week December, Illinois River, bid one barge each week at 160 percent of tariff, offer 167-1/2 percent.
